title: Referral links got a wider net
summary:
A maintenance day for text routing, referral-link handling, and a project credit that needed correcting.

Text responses can now be considered for referral links without Markdown formatting. Three affiliate matches were added, referral-link processing became more frequent, and the fallback Ko-fi prompt became less frequent. Legacy ad and referral code was removed.

The website project list and README now credit Pink Pixel as the author of MCPollinations. Its description and links did not change.

DeepSeek and Portkey handling was refactored in the text API, including model mappings and endpoint selection for DeepSeek-V3.
